profile.summary: Roku is a company that runs a TV streaming platform. It makes streaming players, Roku-branded televisions and other devices, and its Roku operating system lets viewers watch streaming apps (channels) from content partners. It earns money from advertising, from streaming services distribution and from device sales.

sources.title: Roku, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025

review.notes: The 10-K cover page shows Roku, Inc. at 1173 Coleman Avenue, San Jose, which matches the agenda's San Jose, CA. A 'Distribution Agreement' with Roku fits its channel distribution business. The summary matches the 10-K's description of its devices and platform segments and is neutral. The website is the official roku.com.
